channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: ‘Hope taken away’: Families of children diagnosed with rare disease heartbroken over NHS drug decision
item.description: A funding decision for the sole treatment that slows the progression of Batten Disease has been made. Children diagnosed have a life expectancy between six and 12 years, writes Victoria Macdonald.

item.title: Failure to stop rapist underscores ‘toxic culture within policing’, says Victims’ Commissioner
item.description: We spoke to Clare Waxman, who is the Victims’ Commissioner for England and Wales, and asked for her reaction to our investigation.

item.title: Inflation falls in the UK – but all is not rosy for Rachel Reeves
item.description: Petrol is getting cheaper and food prices aren't rising as fast, and that's helped bring inflation down to its lowest level since March last year.

item.title: Six Palestine Action activists face retrial
item.description: Six Palestine Action activists are to face a retrial on charges of criminal damage in connection with a break-in at the UK site of Elbit systems, a defence firm based in Israel.

item.title: Trump says Starmer making ‘big mistake’ over Chagos Islands deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump has taken to social media to say Prime Minister Keir Starmer is making a "big mistake" over the UK's Chagos Islands deal.

item.title: More train stations promised for Wales in ‘rail transformation’
item.description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer and the Welsh First Minister have been in Taff's Well, near Cardiff, announcing £14 billion in UK government funding to transform Wales' rail network, including seven new stations.

item.title: Elderly widower left to pay £40,000 bill for pile of illegal waste
item.description: When an 80-year-old farmer found out that illegal fly tippers had left a huge pile of waste on his land, he reported it.

item.title: Fallout after Real Madrid star Vinicius Junior alleges abuse from Benfica opponent
item.description: Real Madrid's match against Benfica last night was suspended for 10 minutes after Madrid player Vinicius Junior was allegedly subjected to racial abuse.

item.title: Using comedy to fight back against climate change
item.description: What's funny about the end of the planet in a fiery inferno?

item.title: Mourning the victims of Iran’s brutal protest crackdown
item.description: Israel has reportedly put its forces on heightened alert amid growing speculation that US military action against Iran could be imminent.
